July 2013 – British Savate Assaut Championships 2013: Results

Around 30 fighters competed in the British Savate Assaut Championships on 30th January 2013, held at Fight Science gym in Aldershot.

The new 2013 Champions are:
65-70kg Male: Tim Campbell (Cambridge)
70-75kg Male: James Antill (Guildford)
75-80kg Male: James Southwood (London)
80-85kg Male: Kalle Heinola (Oxford)
85+kg Male: Rufus Bazley (London)

Congratulations to our new champions, and very great thanks to all of the dedicated officials who gave up their time so generously to make the day run so smoothly!

Great Britain Savate Federation
